basic_info.description: Welcome to this bright and airy condo, perfectly situated in San Francisco's coveted Marina District. Nestled on the first floor of a boutique 21-unit building, this 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers modern comfort with a touch of elegance. The recently refreshed kitchen boasts stunning new countertops, a sleek low-profile microwave, and Bluetooth-enabled recessed lighting. Enjoy all the natural light pouring in through tall bay windows.   This home includes a dedicated 1-car garage with additional storage, making city living even more convenient. Located just steps from bus lines for easy access to the Financial District and Market Street, and a mere block from Marina Green and the iconic Palace of Fine Arts. Take a short stroll to Crissy Field Beach, the Presidio, Fort Mason's Sunday farmers market, and enjoy the vibrant restaurants and boutiques on Chestnut Street.
